### Facilities
- 24/7 CCTV Security
- Fully Furnished Rooms (Single, Double, Triple Sharing)
- 100% Vegetarian Home-style Food (Breakfast, Lunch, Snacks, Dinner)
- High-Speed WiFi
- Power Backup
- Housekeeping
- RO Water Purifier
- Laundry Service
- Attached Bathrooms
- Study Area
- Common Room
- Prayer Room
- Terrace

### Admission Process
1. Fill online admission form at https://shrilakshmipg.com/#admission
2. Submit Aadhaar Card, College/Work ID, and Passport size photo
3. Warden reviews the application
4. Visit and confirm room preference
5. Pay security deposit (refundable, 2 months rent)
6. Move in

### Rules
- Main gate closes at 9:30 PM
- Family visitors allowed 9 AM to 7 PM with prior registration
- Outside food not allowed in rooms
- No overnight guests
- Silence after 10 PM in study areas

### Pricing
- Rent range: ₹6,000 - ₹15,000 per month
- Includes: Room rent, food, WiFi, housekeeping
- Security deposit: Refundable (2 months rent)
